trigger_condition.value_trigger: All elements along the softmax reduction dimension are -inf.
trigger_condition.execution_trigger: Softmax is called on a fully masked reduction slice with no finite values.
trigger_condition.concrete_constraints: Input tensor contains one or more rows or slices where all values are -inf, causing the softmax normalization denominator to become zero.

bug_oracle.description: torch.softmax returns NaN values when an entire reduction dimension contains -inf; expected safe softmax behavior returns zeros.

harness_strategy.input_mutation: Replace random tensor elements with -inf, inf, and NaN; generate fully masked rows or slices.
harness_strategy.tensor_construction: Generate tensors such as torch.full((B, S), float('-inf')) and mixed tensors containing finite and -inf rows.
harness_strategy.constraint_injection: Apply attention-like masks that remove all valid positions for selected rows along the target softmax dimension.
harness_strategy.operation_sequence: Call torch.softmax on the constructed tensor along the target dimension.
harness_strategy.oracle_construction: Check outputs with torch.isnan and compare fully -inf slices against an expected zero-valued result.
